name: Headspace
storyline: After an electrical accident at your computer, you suddenly find yourself trapped inside your own mind! To make things worse, thanks to your mind-numbing job and over-reliance on the internet, your mind is creatively bankrupt - bleak nothingness as far as the eye can see, while malicious Dark Thoughts roam the depths of your subconscious. With the power of Inspiration, your lewd Fantasies, and long-lost Memories, there might just be a way to repair your broken mind and escape the confines of your Headspace!
summary: A NSFW Adventure-RPG where you either subdue or seduce the various denizens of your imagination, all while trying to remember who you are. Can you escape the confines of your Headspace?
